name: Rivals with Benefits
source:
Your senior year at VCSU seems perfect... until you find yourself in a housing battle with the charming president of the rowdiest frat on campus.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Rivals_with_Benefits]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你在VCSU的高年级看起来很完美……直到你发现自己与校园里最吵闹的兄弟会的迷人主席发生了一场住房大战。

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Rivals_with_Benefits]Choices Wikia[/url]]
